glossary.definition: The role accountable for decisions and review of a defined process.
An agreed statement of where a mapped process starts and ends, naming the triggering event, the output, and the recipient, without implying that work outside the boundary is unimportant.
The point at which one role passes an output to another role, considered complete only when the receiving role has what it needs to act.
